const c = document.querySelector('#panel-register input[name=classCode]'); c.value = ''; c.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); 'cleared'

assert: document.querySelector('#panel-register .field.has-error .error').textContent === "That class code isn't right. Check with your teacher."
